decision.reason: Olympus official 13 Oct FDA warning statement gives dated multi-site QMS remediation and response workflow; explicitly no recall/restriction.

opportunities.idea_name: Medical Device FDA QMS Warning Response Ledger
opportunities.core_job: Trace medical-device inspection findings to corrective evidence and dated response commitments across sites
opportunities.target_customer: Multi-site medical-device manufacturers, quality assurance leaders and regulatory affairs teams
opportunities.product_mechanism: Manually entered warning-letter items, site, inspection reference, assigned CAPA, planned response date, evidence references, reviewer signoff and version history; deterministic checklist, no FDA API
opportunities.why_now: Olympus 13 October announced FDA warning letter covering multi-site QMS processes and committed response within 15 business days; press release expressly says no recall or restriction.
opportunities.before_state: FDA findings, site CAPA evidence and response dates split between quality/regulatory teams.
opportunities.after_state: One warning-response evidence matrix with owners, deadlines, response versions and human review.
opportunities.zero_cost_hypothesis: CSV/manual input with deterministic browser comparison; competitor and history research deferred to Merge/Validation
